newsitem.title: USA: MSB sets earnings improvement plan.
newsitem.headline: MSB sets earnings improvement plan.

text.p: MSB Bancorp Inc said it will implement a "reengineering plan" designed to increase company earnings and stockholder value.
The company said the it expects the plan to result in about $600,000 in additional income in 1997 and about $1.7 million in added income on an annual basis thereafter.
MSB said it will recognize a one-time charge of about $130,000 in the second quarter due to the reorganization.
It said it plans to buy back up to five percent of its common stock, cut expenses, and introduce product pricing initiatives and new products and services.
Certain positions will be eliminated effective July 11, the company said. The positions being cut are primarily managerial and should result in an annual cost savings of about $357,000, MSB said.
It expects to reduce employee costs by about $757,000 annually once the plan is fully implemented, MSB said.
